s01_bottom_line.text: The article states German computer, electronics and electrical equipment companies are meaningfully contributing to export growth thanks to the worldwide AI infrastructure buildout, with AI-exposed goods materially outperforming total exported goods over the past year.
The article draws that spillovers from the global AI cycle point to healthy German export growth ahead.

German industrial/electronics exporters with AI-infrastructure exposure are a possible investable channel for the AI capex cycle, though the article names no specific listed companies and quantifies no earnings effect.
